svg.title: Bubble, Selection & Insertion Sort
svg.desc: Bubble, Selection & Insertion Sort. The three simple O(n²) sorts compared, and why insertion sort still runs inside fast library sorts on short runs. Step 1, Bubble sort: Bubble sort swaps out-of-order neighbours; each pass parks the largest remaining value at the end. Step 2, Selection sort: Selection sort scans for the smallest remaining value, then one swap puts it in place. Step 3, Insertion sort: Insertion sort lifts the next value, shifts larger ones right and drops it into the gap. Step 4, Same O(n²), not alike: All O(n²), yet insertion sort adapts to nearly sorted input: libraries use it for short runs.
